sloka: आराधिता हि शीलेन प्रयत्नैः च उपसेविताः ।राजानः सम्प्रसीदन्ति प्रकुप्यन्ति विपर्यये ॥२-२६-३५॥
transliteration: ārādhitā hi śīlena prayatnaiḥ ca upasevitāḥ ।rājānaḥ samprasīdanti prakupyanti viparyaye ॥2-26-35॥

translations.english: Kings are gratified if they are served with zeal and good conduct. If the contrary happens, they get provoked.
